item.title: Zuckerberg's Meta Takes Down No Kings Instagram During Protest Day
NY announces game ownership bill requiring ownership rather than licensing
item.description:
📝 "Games with online functionality would also be required to provide an offline mode before the servers supporting them are shut down. Players want to be able to enjoy their games even if the publisher decides to stop supporting the game, but Sony doesn’t think the players own their games and that they have the right to pull the rug from under them. Torres in his announcement of the Power to the Players Act; NBA 2K25 is being pulled from digital storefronts, with the online servers being shut down only two years after release, leaving players unable to use a main feature of the game they purchased, and new players unable to purchase the game at all.
🔗 Read more: https://www.tomshardware.com/video-games/new-york-rep-announces-game-ownership-bill-that-would-require-consumer-ownership-rather-than-sale-of-licenses-would-also-require-publishers-to-keep-the-game-functional-after-support-ends

item.title: JDK 28
item.description:
📝 This release will be the Reference Implementation of version 28 of the Java SE Platform, as specified by JSR 403 in the Java Community Process. The main line is open for bug fixes, small enhancements, and JEPs as proposed and tracked via the JEP Process. Early-access binaries, under the GPL, are available here.
🔗 Read more: https://openjdk.org/projects/jdk/28/
